literal_meaning: হাতে কড়ি বা শিকল পরানো (to wear handcuffs or shackles on hands)
figurative_meaning_en: to be arrested or caught for a crime
example_sentences_in_bangla: চোরটিকে পুলিশ হাতকড়া পরিয়ে নিয়ে গেল।
সে তার ভুলের জন্য হাতকড়া পরার মতো লজ্জিত হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: The police put handcuffs on the thief and took him away.
He felt as ashamed as if he were in handcuffs for his mistake.
note: This idiom draws from traditional and modern legal practices in Bengal, symbolizing capture and restraint.
